description:
• Brand introduction: One Thousand Roads EWOT was founded in 2018 to bring the many benefits of Exercise with Oxygen Therapy (EWOT) to more people by making EWOT more affordable and accessible. After a lifetime of strange illness, our founder, Brad Pitzele, used EWOT to help overcome his Lyme disease and cancer, but he recognized that most people with chronic illnesses were priced out of being able to afford an EWOT system.  He launched One Thousand Roads to change that.


• Product description:  EWOT is a close cousin of Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (HBOT) that offers many of the same benefits in much shorter timeframe.  EWOT is anti-aging, improves the metabolism, anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, immune-supporting, and improves athletic performance.  While HBOT requires 90 or more minutes in a pressurized tube at a doctor’s office (at the cost of $300-$600 per session), EWOT can be done in 15 minutes in your own home.  You can read the EWOT research, learn more on our EWOT blog, and read up on EWOT benefits.  People use EWOT to improve athletic performance, or to support chronic conditions such as cancer, Lyme disease, Long COVID, chronic fatigue, traumatic brain injuries, and auto-immune conditions.


• USP (Unique Selling Point): One Thousand Roads offers the most-affordable, high-quality EWOT system on the market, which makes our systems affordable to many more people.  We also offer a no-wait-time EWOT solution.  Our EWOT systems are designed to be used with a smart outlet or digital outlet timer to allow the reservoir to be filled and waiting for you whenever you want to use it.  Simply program the timer to fill the reservoir so that it is full and ready whenever you want to do your EWOT session – first thing in the morning, right after work, etc.  Other systems will not work with a digital timer because they require you to manually turn on the oxygen pump after the unit is powered on or they have loud and annoying power fail alarms that will be activated when the timer turns them on or off.  This means you need to turn them on manually and then wait over an hour to use your system.  With OTR EWOT systems, the system can be ready whenever you are – no waiting needed, making EWOT much more convenient.


• Payment terms: 45 days (to allow for returns)

• Other information:  We are mission-driven brand seeking to help people improve their health, wellness and quality of life.  Beyond a business, this is a passion for us and we are looking for passionate afffilites who want to help us radically change the health and wellness of people through the amazing power of EWOT.
